run_finalize_hypothesis: run the finalize_hypothesis CLI tool to validate hypotheses against Wikidata from a JSONL input file
run_check_match: run check_match to verify if a Wikidata snak matches a given test string for amounts or dates
run_get_unit: run get_unit to fetch and cache a Wikidata unit's English name by its URI
review_check_match: review the check_match function to understand how it handles numeric amounts and time precision matching
refactor_finalize_hypothesis: refactor the finalize_hypothesis main block to support additional hypothesis validation strategies
